verdict.rationale: OpenHands ships an official Software Agent SDK, a composable Python library. Its first-party guides cover custom agents, custom tools (Action/Observation/Executor), structured agent settings, async parallel execution, and an Agent Server that exposes the SDK over HTTP/WebSocket. missing for 10: SDKs in languages other than Python, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Software Agent SDK is a composable Python library for building agents that work with code.
The SDK's tool system is built around three core components: Action ... Observation ... Executor
This guide demonstrates how to create custom agents tailored for specific use cases.
The Agent Server package (`openhands-agent-server`) runs the OpenHands Software Agent SDK behind an HTTP and WebSocket API.
`OpenHandsAgentSettings` gives you a structured, serializable way to define an agent's model, tools, and optional subsystems like the condenser.
